extension.description: Dieses Add-on basiert auf dem Code von https://github.com/mediathekview/plugin.video.mediathekview[CR][CR]Ermöglicht den Zugriff auf fast alle deutschen Mediatheken der öffentlich Rechtlichen basierend auf der Datenbank von MediathekView.de

This add-on is based on the code of https://github.com/mediathekview/plugin.video.mediathekview[CR][CR]Gives access to most video-platforms from German public service broadcasters using the database of MediathekView.de
extension.disclaimer: This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
extension.news:
v1.2.0 - The add-on is now called MediathekView+. Only the name changed; your settings and your database stay where they are. - Kodi stays usable while the film database is updated. - Shows with several seasons open on their seasons instead of one long list, and their episodes are in episode order. - Films say what they are: season and episode as "1x11.", the broadcast date as a date, whether they have subtitles, which channel they are from, and whether the stream is HD. All of that used to be packed into the title and the description. - Kodi keeps the view you picked for a folder. The add-on no longer chooses one for you. - tagesschau24, ZDFinfo and ZDFneo show their logo again.
v1.1.0 - Updating the film database no longer gets in the way. The downloaded file is unpacked several times faster, the progress is shown, and it can be interrupted. - Searching is behind one menu entry instead of two. "Quick Search" and "Search" were the same search with a different number of fields. - Saved searches have been removed. Searches saved with an earlier version are no longer offered. - The search history keeps the last 25 terms instead of growing for as long as the add-on is used.
v1.0.1 - Fixed: after a fresh installation the add-on did not start at all. Neither the user interface nor the background update would come up. - An unreadable setting no longer stops the add-on. It falls back to the intended default and notes that in the log.
v1.0.0 - First release of this fork.
